Pizza Ride

Avondale Estates, GA · Road

Pizza Ride is a road group ride in Avondale Estates, GA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Art Lot. Pace: moderate to strenuous, several paces.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate to strenuous, several paces. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pizza Ride group ride

One of the long-running Atlanta road rides. Leaves the Art Lot in Avondale Estates Thursday evenings and splits into groups by pace and distance. Runs year-round. Pizza afterward is the point.
